title: BrillaPrep curriculum question batch
description: Loose envelope for curriculum question batches; the authoritative rules live in scripts/question-content-lib.mjs. Question types: multiple_choice, short_answer, calculation (objective) plus essay and structured (theory). Theory questions carry marks >= 2, a per-question contentLabel stating the content is not official WAEC material, and either markingScheme.points (essay) or parts (structured) whose marks sum to the question marks.
